postingQuotes: Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company.

We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec.

This role reports into our VP, Global Supply Chain and brings together two functions that have to move as one: the engineers who industrialize our components and equipment, and the quality systems and team that hold our suppliers accountable once they are producing.
Director, Supplier Industrialization Engineering

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec.
* Develop the roadmap and staffing plan for quality systems aligned to relevant standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949) at a scale and stage appropriate to where Form is today and where we are headed.
*When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents.
And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join.

Form's 85% domestically sourced supply chain was built for a battery chemistry with no existing supplier base, which means the industrialization playbook and the quality systems we need are still being written.
* Experience building quality and industrialization systems from the ground up, ideally in a hardware, energy, or battery environment without an established supplier base to lean on.
You will fly high enough to set the strategy and the org, and go deep enough to sit in a root cause review when it matters.
* Lead Form's Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Supplier Quality organization, growing a team of engineers embedded across battery materials, components, and equipment categories.

 Production System Design and NPI

* Working in conjunction with technical teams, provide vendor management support in all logistics and operations to ensure on-time delivery of materials
* Coordinate the design and execution of cross-functional CMC project p

* Maintain frequent communication with cross-functional CMC project team members and key internal stakeholders so that all parties are aware of current project status, issues, contingencies, milestones, and budgets
* Proactively identify the CMC critical path, risks, and impediments to successful

========================================================

Req Id: 3772

Work Model: On-Site

Company: Philip Morris USA

State/Province: Virginia

Job Description:

**Together We Innovate. Together We Change.**

 

We are seeking a **Senior Manager, Manufacturing Training** to lead all salaried and hourly training across Cigarette Manufacturing (CM) and Primary, including logistics. This strategic role sets direction, clears roadblocks and owns the budget.

* Own the ISO 9001 training quality system and align all training groups to it.
* Set strategy for major initiatives such as North Pole Export, and sponsor training modernization, the innovation strategy and the Manufacturing Knowledge Center.
* Set training-wide objectives, metrics and trainer qualification standard; represent training on the Intergrated Work Systems (IWS) Education & Training Pillar.

**Position Description:**

* The Plant Manager is responsible for assisting the Director of Plant Services in engineering, custodial, and minor maintenance at selected facilities as assigned by the Director of Plant Services by starting, stopping, and observing all equipment that is interconnected with the air conditioning and/or heating system, safety, security, cleanliness, and the entire appearance at various facilities.
* The position can require extend or on call work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety or operational routine.

**Scope of

* Sets up for assemblies, conferences, plays, programs when required.
* Supervises custodial staff, inspects their work, assigns duties, keeps and reports the time for himself/ herself and personnel, etc. in coordination with principal.
* Light maintenance functions, makes minor repairs such as replacing faucet handles, light switches, door knobs and door adjustments, glass repairs, painting, etc. for all buildings on school plant.
* Responsible to carry and answers system issued iPhone before, during and after normal work hours due to emergencies or extenuating circumstances related to safety

* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with an ability to use quantitative and qualitative data to make decisions and recommendations.
* Collaborative management style, with a proven track record of working with diverse individuals at all levels to drive decision-making and results.
* Maintain a valid Louisiana drivers’ license.
* Have knowledge of driving laws, interpreting traffic signals, signs.
* Ability to operate a manual transmission.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED/Hi Set
* Two years of experience in a mechanical trade.
* Two years of college
